From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Thompson <c.thompson@helixpay.com>; Samir Gupta <samir.g@helixpay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Execution cadence & MAP — HelixPay onboarding

Hi Claire / Samir,

Congrats again on signing — excited to get HelixPay into production. Attached is a first-pass execution cadence I put together to live inside the MAP workbook. High-level ask: can you confirm target live date (you mentioned late Nov) and any blackout dates for migration or training?

Key proposal (summary):
- Kickoff call: week of Nov 22 (customer requested)
- Canary window: 2-week canary beginning Nov 29; limited to 5% traffic and two routes (ACH & Card).
- Migration approach: staged routing with prefix caching; rolling cutover by region (US-East then US-West).
- Training: two 90-minute sessions for ops + one hands-on runbook walkthrough for engineers (pre-canary).
- Acceptance gates: live smoke tests, latency < 300ms p95 for core routes, degradation rollback policy.

Deliverables attached: HelixPay-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook with owners/dates) and a short canary checklist. Please review owners and proposed owners from our side (rows highlighted). I set Monica as PM for the rollout and Laura as lead for training.

Next steps (please):
1) Confirm kickoff week and any date constraints by EOD Mon Nov 9.
2) Share any compliance or SOC-reqs we should fold into the MAP (if not already shared).
3) Identify a tech contact for day-of cutover (if Samir is the best contact, confirm).

Attachments: [HelixPay-MAP-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [canary-checklist.md (text/markdown)]

Thanks,

--
Nikhil Sharma
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
n.sharma@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0137

- We want production go-live no earlier than Dec 6 (compliance sign-off on Nov 30 could push it later).
- For the canary, prefer Dec 6–19 window instead of late Nov to align with our regression sprint.

Samir will be our day-of technical lead — copying him here. We’ll also need a short run-through with our security team the week before canary.

I’ll review the MAP workbook this weekend and upload any required SOC docs to the Drive link you provided.

Team — quick internal update after Claire's note:

1) Timeline change: move kickoff -> week of Dec 6; canary -> Dec 6–19 (two-week window). Adjusted dates in attached MAP workbook.
2) Owners: Monica (program), Nikhil (SRE/engineer-facing runbook), Laura (training curriculum + ops playbook), Aditya (sales & billing coordination).
3) Training plan:
   - Day -14: Security review w/ HelixPay security (30 mins)
   - Day -7: Ops runbook walkthrough (90 mins)
   - Day -3: Smoke test rehearsal w/ staged traffic (engineers only)
   - Canary week: daily 30-min standups for first 3 business days, then alternate days.
4) Rollback plan: Must be executable within 30 minutes; we’ll pre-provision fallback model variant and region-level cutover steps.

Attachments updated: HelixPay-MAP-v1.xlsx, canary-checklist.md (see checklist section: pre-canary smoke tests, log retention config, KV cache snapshot step).

Action items for this thread:
- @Nikhil: prepare runbook draft by Wed Nov 11.
- @Laura: draft training slidedeck + lab exercise by Fri Nov 13.
- @Aditya: confirm any billing/credit commits for timeline shift.

I’ve added the Drive link and DocuSign envelope to the MAP workbook header. Please review and call out any missing items.
